candidates.requirement: Pass each supplied .lzma input to the decoder once, in byte order.
candidates.target_route: The entry calls fuzz_code, which supplies the first half of the input and later refills lzma_code from the original input pointer.
candidates.failure_condition: When the first half is consumed, the refill repeats its prefix instead of supplying the remaining bytes. A complete valid .lzma input therefore is not decoded as supplied.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete entry makes one fuzz_code call, and the complete helper has no other refill route that advances past the initially supplied half.

before.requirement: Pass each supplied .lzma input to the decoder once, in byte order.
before.reason: The decoder consumes input and advances the stream pointer, but the fixed helper refills from its original input pointer, replaying consumed bytes.

after.requirement: Pass each supplied .lzma input to the decoder once, in byte order.
after.reason: Input consumption and the fixed helper's refill remain the same; the added dictionary-size reset does not advance the helper's input pointer.

claims.reason: Both versions use the same lzma_code input advancement and the same old helper. The only selected change is the dictionary-size reset.
